question: What action is attributed to even the wise person while burning, in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence as the means.
Even the wise person does this.
inference: Even the wise person, while burning, acts in relation to the tip of nectar by means of the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The verb governing the first two accusatives is not present as a separate token in this verse and must be inferred.
plain_english: Even the wise person, burning, [acts] at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
